response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), s AS (SELECT circuitId, race_count, race_count * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.circuitId, s.race_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS excess_over_avg FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share ORDER BY excess_over_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average share is taken over circuits that appear in races (grouped by races.circuitId), so circuits with no races are excluded. This equals 1 divided by the number of such circuits.
Ties at 10th place are broken arbitrarily by LIMIT 10, as the request allows.
